Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, orange, guava or papaya)

Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable curry + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Try to eat meals at similar times even with shift work.
Since your daily activity is low, include a 20–30 minute walk on most days.
Choose homemade spicy foods instead of fried snacks.
Eat a small fruit or curd before attending social gatherings to help control portions.
Aim for consistent sleep to support fat loss and energy levels.
